case_classification.short_description: 3-SM based on percentages + plug without extensive forecasting

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: Building a 120-month monthly 3-statement model with workday-weighted compounding requires precise setup. The modeler must first calculate monthly workdays (using NETWORKDAYS) and annual totals, then implement exponent-based compounding formulas for both P&L and Balance Sheet line items. Additional complexity arises from linking P&L D&A to Balance Sheet accumulated depreciation changes, modeling the cash plug and monthly profit distributions, and constructing a fully reconciled Cash Flow Statement to accurately answer questions regarding operating, investing, and financing cash flows.
